name: AZ Unified Search
author: alexeyaz2012

sections.description:
AZ Unified Search provides one fast search bar for your site:

Without WooCommerce — live suggestions for posts, pages, and other public content using the native WordPress search layer.

With WooCommerce — everything above plus products, product categories, tags, SKU-aware suggestions, prices, and stock-related options.

Free:

  • Live AJAX suggestions (native WordPress search layer)
  • Site search: posts and pages (always available; more post types in Search config without WooCommerce)
  • With WooCommerce: product title, description, short description, and parent SKU
  • With WooCommerce: matching categories and tags in autocomplete
  • Suggestion UI: images, price, SKU display, badges, limits, colors
  • With WooCommerce: exclude out-of-stock products
  • Shortcode, block, and theme embedding helpers
  • Core Free search works without contacting external servers

Pro (sold on azdev.tech; requires Pro package + license key):

  • Dedicated TNT MySQL search index
  • Fuzzy search (typos)
  • Synonyms
  • Search in custom fields (ACF and others)
  • Search in product attributes
  • Search in categories/tags as sources (+ category thumbnails)
  • Brands (+ thumbnails)
  • Variation SKU search
  • Posts / pages / custom post types in autocomplete (with WooCommerce active)
  • Conditional product exclusion rules
  • TranslatePress and other Pro multilingual / catalog integrations
  • License activation against azdev.tech

Author: Alexey A. Zubenko
Plugin website: https://azdev.tech

External services

This WordPress.org package does not connect to external services and does not send visitor or admin data off-site.

The optional Pro package sold separately on azdev.tech includes a license client. That separate download (not this listing) may send a license key, site URL, and activation token to https://azdev.tech when an administrator activates, validates, or deactivates a key:
Terms of Service
Privacy Policy

Source files

Block editor JavaScript lives in src/blocks/ (unminified). Regenerating the files in build/blocks/:

cd src/blocks && npm install && npm run build<h3>Third-party libraries</h3>

Bundled in this wordpress.org package (no remote calls):

  • jQuery plugins used by the search UI (assets/js/search.js and related CSS)
  • Popper.js and Tooltip.js for admin help (GPL-compatible MIT)

Vue.js and Selectize are not included in this wordpress.org package. They ship only with the separate Pro package from azdev.tech.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open AZ Unified Search in the WordPress admin menu and configure the search form.
  4. Optional: install WooCommerce to enable product catalog search.
  5. For Pro: install the Pro package from azdev.tech, activate a license key, then rebuild the search index when prompted.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

No. The plugin works on any WordPress site and searches posts, pages, and public content. Install WooCommerce when you also need live product search.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. When WooCommerce is active, product search, categories, tags, prices, and related options are available.

Free vs Pro

The Free build focuses on live suggestions with the WordPress search layer. Pro unlocks the dedicated search index and advanced indexing options. The Free wordpress.org package does not include Pro engine files or a license client; after purchase you install the Pro package and activate a license key.

Which languages are supported?

English (default source language) and Russian (ru_RU). The admin UI and front-end labels follow the WordPress site language.

0.1.15

  • WordPress.org review: finish remaining script/style handles and image size names on azunsearch_* (Helpers, Setup, Personalization).

0.1.14

  • WordPress.org review: register shortcode as [azunsearch] (unique prefix); legacy [az-unified-search] only via pre_do_shortcode_tag.

0.1.13

  • WordPress.org review: do not register third-party AJAX actions or theme shortcode tags; detect them instead.
  • Fix OceanWP early returns that closed Helpers::capture() buffers; sanitize WBW filter AJAX inputs.
  • Org ZIP omits languages/ and Domain Path; load bundled MO only when present (local Free).

0.1.12

  • WordPress.org review: use compact unique prefix azunsearch / AZUNSEARCH (not az_ / az_unified_search_).
  • Migrate stored az_us_* and interim az_unified_search_* options to azunsearch_*.

0.1.11

  • WordPress.org review: lengthen unique prefixes; drop the short [az-search] shortcode alias.
  • Free admin: restore Starting tab; Search bar and Autocomplete two-column preview; hide Pro-only Search config demos; no-WooCommerce defaults search posts and pages.

0.1.10

  • Escape remaining admin SVG/price sinks with wp_kses; drop EscapeOutput ignores used as substitutes.
  • Org ZIP build fails if bare do_shortcode / raw style echoes / EscapeOutput ignores remain.

0.1.9

  • Theme search overrides wrap full HTML fragments in wp_kses (no EscapeOutput ignores as a substitute).

0.1.8

  • Fix fatal error on AJAX search: import AzUnifiedSearch\Post in the native search engine.

0.1.7

  • WordPress.org review: escape shortcode, widget, and theme search markup with wp_kses before it is returned or printed.
  • Move late theme CSS (Bricks icon color, TheGem header builder) onto wp_add_inline_style instead of echoing a style string.

0.1.6

  • WordPress.org review: limit admin notices to plugin screens (Guideline 11); disable dashboard review nags.
  • Sanitize CSS/JS before inline enqueue; escape widget titles; close output buffers via Helpers::capture().
  • Theme compatibility no longer registers common shortcode/AJAX names (search, searchform, load_more).

0.1.5

  • WordPress.org review: Free package scrub removes license gates and premium-only method markers (Guideline 5).
  • Ship composer.json with the package; sanitize debug lang/scope input; harden json_decode handling.

0.1.4

  • WordPress.org review: Free package has no premium-only gates; Pro engine remains a separate package.
  • Enqueue theme CSS/JS instead of printing style/script tags.
  • Sanitize request nonces and search input; escape admin debug fields; use wp_json_encode.
  • Include block editor source files and document bundled libraries.

0.1.3

  • Admin Quick start panel on the Starting tab (menu, block, shortcode, view site).
  • Unified site vs store messaging in settings header, preview, and Search config tab labels.
  • Troubleshooting moved to its own submenu (less noise on main Settings tabs).
  • Free Pro tab renamed to “Pro features”; removed “Increase sales” upsell copy.
  • License block collapsed by default on Free installs; advanced settings shown by default for new setups.
  • Search widget registers without WooCommerce (native WP_Widget fallback).
  • Russian (ru_RU): full admin UI translation for 0.1.3 strings (582/582).

0.1.2

  • WooCommerce is optional: the plugin runs in site search mode without it.
  • Native autocomplete and search results for posts and pages when WooCommerce is inactive.
  • AJAX endpoints fall back to admin-ajax.php when WC AJAX is unavailable.
  • Settings UI hides product-only options without WooCommerce; site content options stay available.
  • Plugin header, readme, and placeholders reflect universal site + optional store search.
  • PCP: taxonomy labels use the plugin text domain.

0.1.1

  • Password-protected content excluded from native search and Pro index.
  • Sale/Featured suggestion badges (optional settings).
  • Safer product thumbnail markup (escaped URLs/attributes).
  • Block API version 3; raised WP/WC compatibility headers.
  • Language files renamed to az-unified-search text domain.
  • Full Russian localization; English remains the source language. Other leftover locales removed.
  • Free/Pro packaging: Pro modules stripped from wordpress.org ZIP; Pro ZIP stamped with AZUNSEARCH_PRO_BUILD; dual gate (modules + license).

0.1.0

  • Initial AZ Unified Search scaffold from Pro search engine base.
  • Renamed plugin identity, bootstrap file, and search endpoint activation check.
